name: mochi
description: Open-source, BYOK animated desktop companion & lifestyle time tracker
// packageManager: Pins pnpm for CI (pnpm/action-setup reads it) and for anyone cloning, since Corepack enforces it locally.
// prepare: Points git at the versioned hooks in .githooks so the pre-push gate is shared rather than living in one person's .git/hooks. Never fails the install: a tarball or a non-repo checkout has no git dir, and that is not an error.
// release:check: Fails a release if the git tag and apps/desktop/package.json disagree. electron-builder reads the version from package.json and ignores tags, so a mismatch publishes the old version under a new tag and silently offers nobody the update.
// verify: Every CI gate, in CI's order, fastest first. Run by the pre-push hook and worth running by hand before asking why CI is red.

scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
